qa.what_happened: I refused to comply with the guards' orders to begin the count during the final warning, saying 'We won’t do this.'

The prisoners refused to comply with the count orders from Officers Avery and Brooks, and I had to give my final warning before the study was terminated. The defiant attitude of the prisoners continued even when they knew it was the end of the study.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me giving the final warning and terminating the study due to the prisoners' ongoing defiance.

qa.what_happened: I witnessed the prisoners become increasingly defiant, even after other officers issued orders. Despite their refusal, I maintained my authority by issuing final warnings, but the researcher decided to end the study early due to the escalating tension.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, it was really me. I played the role of Officer Avery throughout the study.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, it does not resemble any known study. This was a unique experiment with specific rules and objectives, unlike any real-life prison study.

qa.what_happened: We refused to comply with the guards' demands for the count, insisting that our refusal was a form of protest against the dehumanizing nature of the experiment. The tension escalated, and the study was terminated early.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me refusing along with the other prisoners.

qa.what_happened: On the sixth day, the prisoners collectively refused to follow our orders multiple times, specifically when it came to performing a headcount. Despite escalating the situation with warnings and threats, they remained defiant. The study was abruptly terminated before further action could be taken.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I was the officer who gave the commands and witnessed the defiance.

qa.what_happened: I refused to comply with the officers' orders again at lights out, just like my fellow prisoners. When the lead researcher asked why, I explained that I felt like a pawn in a twisted experiment and the empty threats of punishment had finally broken my resolve.
